adherence.reason: The piece is a dialogue-driven scene centered on exchanges between Elara and Kael.
Elara serves as the apparent human representative and Kael is explicitly an obsidian, stone-like alien ambassador.
Their unfamiliarity and cautious introductory interaction imply an initial encounter, but the text never clearly states this is their first meeting.
Every spoken line attributed to Kael is phrased entirely as one or more questions.
The scene is explicitly in a zero-gravity observation deck, satisfying weightlessness but not the requested meeting-room setting.
The exact word "translator" appears near the beginning.
The narration explicitly reveals Elara as a perfect synthetic copy sent because the real Elara was too terrified to face the ambassador.
The final spoken words are Kael asking Elara, "Are you afraid?"
